Serving Suggestions
Try adding cold cereal to reduced-fat or
nonfat yogurt for a crunchy, creamy treat.
Or, top off cold cereal with sliced fruit of
your own choosing.  Fruit added to cereals
by manufacturers is often high in sodium
and sugar, and usually there is not a lot of
it in the box.  Add nutrition to a bowl of
hot or cold cereal by sprinkling wheat bran
or germ over it. 
Flour
Flour is the powdery substance made from
grinding grains.  Flour has been used by
nearly every culture in the world for making
foods—usually breads—that are staples in
the diet.  Wheat is usually used, but flour
